listening.title: Meeting Someone New in the Pantry

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Good morning! Are you waiting for the coffee machine?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Yes, but go ahead. I just need to refill my water bottle.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Thanks. I don't think we've met. I'm Hoa from the finance department.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Hoa. I'm Tuấn. I joined the marketing team last month.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Welcome! How are you finding the company so far?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: I like it, but I still want to get to know more people outside my team.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: You should join our badminton club on Thursdays. Many colleagues go there.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Really? I play badminton every weekend. It looks like we have something in common.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Great! I'll add you to the club group chat. We're always happy to meet a newcomer.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Perfect. Thanks, Hoa. See you on Thursday!
